company.name: Enzymit
company.shortDescription: Enzymit is building a new transformation layer for molecular manufacturing.
company.description: Enzymit is creating a new transformation layer for manufacturing by combining computational enzyme design, deep learning, and a proprietary high-throughput discovery platform. We develop novel enzymatic pathways and run them in controllable cell-free production systems. This approach merges the selectivity of biology with the precision of chemistry, enabling cleaner and more efficient production. Our platform has been validated with pharmaceutical-grade hyaluronic acid (HA), produced at kilogram scale with superior consistency and purity compared to fermentation. We are now advancing toward commercial HA supply while expanding the platform to products like heparin and human milk oligosaccharides (HMOs).

productsAndServices.description: A platform that uses computational protein design and enzymatic manufacturing to produce biomolecules without living cells, enabling faster and more controlled bioproduction.
productsAndServices.name: Cell-Free Bioproduction Platform

productsAndServices.description: Enzymatic production of complex human milk oligosaccharides using a cell-free platform, enabling selective synthesis of large, complex carbohydrates difficult to produce by fermentation or chemical synthesis.
productsAndServices.name: Human Milk Oligosaccharides (HMOs) Production

productsAndServices.description: Enzymatic synthesis of uniform-size hyaluronic acid polymers using a cell-free platform, improving product purity and yield compared to microbial fermentation methods.
productsAndServices.name: Hyaluronic Acid Production

productsAndServices.description: Design and production of novel insulin-like proteins expressed in bacterial cells to reduce costs and improve scalability of growth factors for cultivated meat production.
productsAndServices.name: Novel Insulin-Like Proteins for Cultivated Meat

productsAndServices.description: Development of protein-based biosensors with enhanced specificity and sensitivity for detecting trace harmful substances in environmental and industrial applications.
productsAndServices.name: Novel Protein-Based Biosensors

productsAndServices.description: Development of novel enzymes to degrade polyolefin plastics, addressing challenges of plastic waste management through enzymatic breakdown rather than chemical methods.
productsAndServices.name: Enzymatic Plastic Degradation Solutions
